notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Roadmap v1 deck (6 slides: cover, phasing rationale, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, milestones & owners). The cover and phasing-rationale slides surface engine totals (effort hours, cost, scenario, assumptions) and engagement context. Per-phase scope on slides 3-5 is filled with AI-written narrative via `section.phase_<N>_scope` (sections declared in `deliverable-templates/roadmap.json`). The milestones panel on slide 6 is filled with AI-synthesised milestones via `section.milestones_owners` — replaces the previous raw recommendations-bulletList dump. The owners table on slide 6 is intentionally blank for the team to fill in. seed: {"name":"Roadmap","version":"v1","kind":"ROADMAP"}
